What is the trace in the xz-plane of the elliptic paraboloid z−1=x24+y22.

a
Two intersecting lines: x=±y4
b
A hyperbola: x24−z2=1
c
Two parallel lines: y=14(z±3)
d
A parabola: z=x24+1
e
A parabola: z=1−x24
